split: within_run.py logic: default_rng(0) permutation of non-seeds; val = first 10%, stop = next 10% of rest

mlp_full.notes: MLP+ReLU (fluniml.mlp, 'full' features, 3-seed ensemble), trained on fit agents, early-stopped on stop set

gat_daily.notes: GATDaily (train_gat_agent_split.py logic, defaults except epochs capped at 12 with cosine schedule over 12, patience 12, for time); loss on fit agents, model selection by stop-set AP (original selects on val AP)

meanfield_js.notes: model/meanfield.js defaults via ml/scripts/kl_frankenstein.mjs; p = 1 - S at final step (P ever infected, incl. 2% prior mass)

meanfield_js_calibrated.notes: model/meanfield.js with prior = n_seeds/N = 5/7500 and lambdaScale refit (meanfield-cli --calibrate procedure: true seeds, no reports, prior 0, no imports, geometric bisection, bracket grown from [0.01,1] until it holds the target) to a train-agents-only target; reports included in scored run; p = 1 - S final

meanfield_js_fit_reports.notes: model/meanfield.js with prior = 5/7500 and lambdaScale fitted on the full scored model (reports included) so mean P(ever infected) over train agents = their attack rate (ml/scripts/kl_mf_fit.mjs, Illinois method; see mf_fit_frankenstein.log); p = 1 - S final

meanfield_js_raw+isotonic.notes: reference: isotonic regression of raw meanfield_js p_ever fitted on train (fit+stop) agents, applied to val

const_val_rate.notes: constant p = val attack rate: cheats on prevalence (per-agent KL = H(ybar), aggregate KL = 0)
